title: NoticeMe
description: Notifies about visits to the Discord server via WebHook
body:
**Discord Join Notifications** is a lightweight plugin that sends a message to a Discord channel whenever a player joins the server.

The plugin uses a **Discord webhook**, making setup quick and simple.
Perfect for server owners who want to monitor activity or keep their community informed in real time.

### Features

* Sends a Discord message when a player joins
* Uses Discord Webhooks
* Lightweight and fast
* Easy configuration

### Use cases

* Track player activity
* Notify staff when players join
* Keep your Discord community updated
